patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports a 6-month history of fatigue and an unintentional weight loss of 5 kg (11 lb) despite maintaining a good appetite. He denies any recent changes in his diet or physical activity. He takes no medications and does not smoke or use illicit drugs.

Secondary_Symptoms: 5 kg unintentional weight loss over 6 months

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: No significant past medical history. Patient denies any chronic illnesses or prior hospitalizations.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Retired engineer; denies tobacco use or illicit drug use. Drinks alcohol socially.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies fever, night sweats, changes in bowel or bladder habits, recent infections, or bleeding disorders.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and abnormal physical examination findings.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, for the past six months I’ve had increasing fatigue and I’ve lost about 5 kilograms without trying, even though my appetite has stayed good. I’m generally feeling more tired than usual, but I haven’t had fever, night sweats, or any changes in my bowel or bladder habits.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or the whites of my eyes. I haven’t had fever or night sweats either, and my bowel and bladder habits have stayed the same.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel stiffness in your joints or muscles when you wake up in the morning?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed significant stiffness in my joints or muscles when I wake up—nothing that feels worse in the mornings. Mostly it’s just the ongoing fatigue and the weight loss despite eating normally.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been confused—I’m thinking clearly and staying oriented. I just feel persistently tired and I’ve lost weight over the last six months even though I’m eating well.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a firm lump or swelling inside your thigh muscle (not just on the skin), especially one that’s been there for a while or is getting bigger?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any firm lump or swelling inside my thigh muscles, and I haven’t felt any area that seems to be growing. It’s been mainly the persistent fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss over the past six months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions or unusual spots along the veins on your arm (for example, along the inner arm where veins are more visible)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any unusual skin lesions or spots along the veins in my arms, and I don’t have anything that seems out of the ordinary. It’s mostly been this persistent fatigue and the unintentional 5 kg weight loss over six months despite eating normally.”
